When you design something for 3D printing make sure that it obeys the laws of physics. Just because it looks pretty in your CAD software doesn't mean it can exist in the real world.

I say this after trying to find a single iPhone case CAD file that can exist in reality. Sigh.🤔

1454990373479145477.a:
To every single person who has ever designed a phone case to look cool:
You can't put a 45 degree outer bevel on thin box edge. There's like 0.05mm of material in your design. This might even work on your broken 3D Printer. When you try to print it on a 3D printer that works...💣
